requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

4399-4770-6626--228.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life, doubled by The Wind Crystal.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life, doubled by the Wind Crystal.
Repeat.
4399-4770-6626--228.notes:
The infinite lifeloss and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5567-5686-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5567-5686-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

751-2226-2499.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
751-2226-2499.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Shrieking Drake enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

2604-5078-5642.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

728-4419-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
728-4419-4694-7306.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

465-3817-3899.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

586-1796-3899-5258-5618.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5870-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5870-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

997-2738-4871-6255.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Zahur, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-5361-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-5361-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Auton Soldier and Pirated Copy each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-5361-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1636-1719-5371-7629.description:
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Hourglass of the Lost.
Repeat.
1636-1719-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

4871-5147-6705.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Quina.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-3499-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
3259-3499-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

4067-5672-7203.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
4067-5672-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other creatures
4067-5672-7203.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Brigid
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2872-5921-5970-6965.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

972-2792-6991.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-2792-6991.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Donnie & April by paying its mana cost.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Donnie & April and the Great Whale token.
Put the Donnie & April token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-2792-6991.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Great Whale and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Donnie & April instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

1170-1329-1482-2079.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2665-2743-6657.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Progenitor Mimic's trigger.
Resolve both triggers, creating two token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1350-1849-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-1849-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

2047-2707-5733-6504.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2047-2707-5733-6504.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Conjurer's Bauble.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate the Conjurer's Bauble token by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Notorious Throng onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Notorious Throng from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

647-1270-3228-5477.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

560-1940-4550-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-1940-4550-5256.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Repeat.

3399-3593-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
3399-3593-4050.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Stormfront Riders from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Stormfront Riders enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, returning it and any other creature you control from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders' second ability triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Soldier, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2104-2556-2963.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

1379-1651-3685-3698-4497.notablePrerequisites: Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
1379-1651-3685-3698-4497.description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding {7} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {7}.
Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Grinding Station.
Resolve the Spine of Ish Sah trigger, destroying target permanent.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Grinding Station and Spine of Ish Sah, untapping Slobad.
Repeat.

618-2178-2290.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Spike Feeder with haste, that enters the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing both +1/+1 counters from it.
Spike Feeder dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Spike Feeder abilities, causing you to gain four life.
Repeat.

570-2011.notablePrerequisites:
Najeela and Faeburrow Elder do not have summoning sickness.
You control a blue and a black permanent.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
570-2011.description:
Declare Najeela and Faeburrow Elder as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink, and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

992-4468.description:
All creatures lose flying and Islandwalk.
Moat prevents things without flying from attacking.
Creatures can not fulfill the conditions nessasary to attack.
